definitions.explanation: An indefinite number of hours, typically implying somewhere between two and five or six hours.

examples.japanese: {数時間|すうじかん}⟦{待|ま}った→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
⟦{手術|しゅじゅつ}→手術：03218_shujutsu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{数時間|すうじかん}⟦かかる→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧⟦{見込|みこ}み→見込み：06872_mikomi⟧だ。
examples.english: The surgery is expected to take several hours.

examples.japanese: ⟦{停電|ていでん}→停電：03544_teiden⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{数時間|すうじかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{使|つか}えなかった→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: Due to the power outage, electricity was unavailable for several hours.

notes:
A common time expression using the prefix ⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (several) with the time counter ⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧ (hours).

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{数分|すうふん}→数分：21623_suufun⟧: several minutes
- ⟦{数日|すうじつ}→数日：20517_suujitsu⟧: several days
- ⟦{数週間|すうしゅうかん}→数週間：21615_suushuukan⟧: several weeks
- {数ヶ月|すうかげつ}: several months
- ⟦{数年|すうねん}→数年：28206_suunen⟧: several years

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {数時間|すうじかん}⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧: several hours later
- {数時間|すうじかん}⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧: several hours ago
- {数時間|すうじかん}おき⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧: every few hours
- {数時間|すうじかん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧わたって: for several hours (duration)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{何時間|なんじかん}→何時間：30372_nanjikan⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧: some hours — slightly more vague
- {二、三時間|にさんじかん}: two or three hours — narrower range
